This is not a gate/scanner weakening: the contract remains exact, desktop-only and still rejects every business setting. The other two REDs seen in the old offline bundle are stale-bundle-only assertions already diverged from current main and are not added to scope. No production code has been pushed after amendment-1; the amendment-1 continuation head 90d642455c5f9f7895e73b042bc42e0e00f61b69 remains tests-only and is frozen as the second parent for the next continuation. After adding this single companion test path, full source-graph closure is unknownBlockers=0. Production scope remains the same eight paths; no backend route, database, dependency, workflow, scanner, gate, routing policy, second renderer, or new general-purpose Yance infrastructure is authorized.
